_readme: TUES FENCING HIRE — BOOKINGS DATA. This file is the source of truth for the
availability calendar on fencing.html. Edit it on GitHub when a booking
request email arrives. Full instructions live in MAINTAINING.md.
Each booking needs: ref, name, contact, panels, start, end, status.
ref      — the reference from the booking email, e.g. TUES-FH-260718-K4QZ
start    — first day of hire, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive)
end      — last day of hire, YYYY-MM-DD (inclusive)
pending    request received, holds stock on the calendar
confirmed  approved by committee, holds stock
declined   rejected — does NOT hold stock
completed  panels returned — does NOT hold stock
conditionLog — array of dated notes recording panel condition at
hire-out and return (internal record, not shown publicly).
The three bookings below are SAMPLES so the calendar has something to show.
Delete them once real bookings exist.
